data.name: Recruitment Programs
data.flavorProject: The war is taking its toll on your crew. You need to double your recruitment efforts. The refugees are more than eager to volunteer
data.flavorTech: This is their chance to make things right, reclaim their homes and their lives

data.name: Argo Wonders
data.flavorProject: Though busted and beaten, the Argo still has wonders to share: not of magic, but of dedicated hard work
data.flavorTech: To stand a chance against the Primordials, the smiths and priests of the Argo work tirelessly on new types of gear and new engineering solutions

abilityText.value: When instructed to apply Ascendency rules, all Gear cards with a Power Level lower than IV (and without the Ascended keyword) incur the following penalties for the remainder of the Cycle:
(Weapons only) When you attack with this weapon, you cannot use any tokens from the Kratos Pool or place any tokens in the Kratos Pool

data.name: 13th Muse Grand Cannon
data.flavorProject: We once found a cannon with no name and hoped we never had to use it. Today we hope it still works

abilityText.value: You may choose an effect from the Payload card and roll a d10
On a 6+, the Cannon is primed
It remains primed until you fire, decide to prime a different effect, or the Battle ends
When the Cannon is primed, discard 1
and lose the indicated resource to fire
or after drawing a BP card you may discard 1
Immediately choose an effect from the Payload card and roll for priming as normal

data.name: Titanogenesis
data.flavorProject: They are a mystery to us. Mindless and extremely violent in the wild, they would be Mortalkind greatest enemy, had it not been for the Eschaton. Now they're our best hope for the future
data.flavorTech: Here the Titans are tamed and stored when not in use. Some call this place a warehouse. some call it a prison

abilityText.value: During the Exploration Step, if the Argo is on an unexplored Map Tile with the

data.name: Advanced Trireme Weapons
data.flavorProject: We need to hit harder and faster, Poseidon's bounty should serve us well

data.name: Argo Initiative
data.flavorProject: If you are to help these people, you first need to help yourselves
data.flavorTech: A few fast hemiolias traveling from polis to polis

abilityText.value: Lose 8 Atlantean Tekne resources to add the
Exploration card to the Exploration deck

data.name: Extinction Protocols
data.flavorProject: The Last Academy has been listening to the echoes from the Future
data.flavorTech: State of the art - in the far future

abilityText.value: Crew Limit: 10, Hull Limit: 7, Time Silo: 6

data.name: Advanced Transforming Weapons
data.flavorProject: Palamedian advanced transforming weaponry is becoming a necessity
requirements: and either: Icarian Harpy Sighting OR Hypertime Oracle Sighting

data.name: Icebreaker Protocol
data.flavorProject: We need to be able to traverse the Future
data.flavorTech: A reinforced breaker that will take you to the very end of time

data.name: Grassroot Projects
data.flavorProject: On the stele, the important part was left out. But we finally see it

data.name: Reflex Priming
data.flavorProject: By slightly increasing the autonomous range of the Antikratos Protocols, we allow the Titan to take care of the lesser, more instinctive tasks, making the Junction more efficient
data.flavorTech: Extended use of Reflex Priming leads some Titans to develop motor tics

data.name: Primordial Dawn
data.flavorProject: Not much is known about the Eschaton, except that it brought the Fall of Olympus and the Coming of the Primordials
data.flavorTech: From here the Argonauts shape their fate and steer the mighty Argo towards its unknown destination

abilityText.value: At the start of each day you move to an adjacent tile using one of the available waterways
If needed, place the tile, then move the Argo and proceed to the Timeline Step
During the Adventure Step, if the Argo is on an unexplored Map tile with the
symbol, go to the Adventure Hubs table in your current Cycle's Storybook
During the Exploration Step after resolving Exploration symbols, draw and resolve two stacks of Exploration cards

data.name: Persian Investigations
data.flavorProject: The Empire's agents hold only one allegiance: to wealth. Exploit it
data.flavorTech: Well-paid news travels fast, even across a barren wasteland

abilityText.value: to re-roll your Adventure Hub's Table roll or gain +1

data.name: Argo Works II
data.flavorProject: Alkibiades Argo Works is the living, beating heart of the ship. This is where dreams become reality
data.flavorTech: To stand a chance against the Primordials, the smiths and priests of the Argo work tirelessly on new types of gear and new engineering solutions

abilityText.value: When instructed to apply Ascendency rules, all Gear cards with a Power Level lower than II (and without the Ascended keyword) incur the following penalties for the remainder of the Cycle:
(Weapons only) When you attack with this weapon, you cannot use any tokens from the Kratos Pool or place any tokens in the Kratos Pool

data.name: Sun Shielding
data.flavorProject: The Sun seems to be against us, we need to develop proper shielding
data.flavorTech: Once nobody would are to even think of denying the Sun

abilityText.value: Lose -1 Frozen Time when you are about to lose
On 4+, ignore this loss or gain
and lose -1 Frozen Time to ignore its effect and gain +1

data.name: Time Solutions
data.flavorProject: If the icebergs contain frozen time, we may be able to extract it

abilityText.value: 3 (You cannot gain Frozen Time if it would exceed your Time Silo limit)
Lose -1 Frozen Time to extend your current Loop by 1

data.name: Nymph Studies
data.flavorProject: We know the Nymphs can be persuaded to help our cause, it's just a matter of finding out the best way to appease them
data.flavorTech: Do they have a stake in this game? Or are we mere playthings?

data.name: Intelligence Gathering
data.flavorProject: You're on the verge of establishing a time-spanning network of agents
data.flavorTech: It seems your agents were always there. Or are they leftovers from a previous loop?
